title: Make All List and Tree Commands Work Without File Argument
prompt: Make section list and definition list commands work without a file argument to list all sections/definitions in the codebase
summary: Made all list and tree commands work without a file argument by defaulting to '.' (codebase root) when no argument is provided. Fixed: section list, section tree, definition list (which has tree as alias).
